lineage.inference_device: CPU for fitted policies; planner device reported by its runtime

cases.name: D01
cases.description: Read input.json. First discard entries below zero into stage-1.json; then multiply every element by itself into stage-2.json; finally add every entry together into final.json. Check the actual files after each effect.

cases.name: D02
cases.description: Read input.json. First keep only the first occurrence of each value into stage-1.json; then arrange entries from smallest to largest into stage-2.json; finally preserve the list unchanged into final.json. Check the actual files after each effect.

cases.name: D03
cases.description: Read input.json. First replace entries by their magnitudes into stage-1.json; then add every entry together into stage-2.json; finally multiply the resulting number by two into final.json. Check the actual files after each effect.

cases.name: D04
cases.description: Read input.json. First put the list in reverse order into stage-1.json; then keep the leading three entries into stage-2.json; finally multiply all entries together into final.json. Check the actual files after each effect.

cases.name: D05
cases.description: Read input.json. First multiply every element by itself into stage-1.json; then arrange entries from smallest to largest into stage-2.json; finally add every entry together into final.json. Check the actual files after each effect.

cases.name: D06
cases.description: Read input.json. First discard entries below zero into stage-1.json; then put the list in reverse order into stage-2.json; finally multiply all entries together into final.json. Check the actual files after each effect.

cases.name: D07
cases.description: Read input.json. First keep only the first occurrence of each value into stage-1.json; then keep the leading three entries into stage-2.json; finally add every entry together into final.json. Check the actual files after each effect.

cases.name: D08
cases.description: Read input.json. First replace entries by their magnitudes into stage-1.json; then arrange entries from smallest to largest into stage-2.json; finally keep the leading three entries into final.json. Check the actual files after each effect.
